CustomObject.description: Values in the Global Value Set 'Grades'. This Custom Metadata Type was created in order to be able to query those values and remove certain values from a record choice set displayed to the user before they create additional Lottery Capacity records via flow Program_Term_Application_Timeline_Screen_Flow_Create_Lottery_Capacity_records. We are removing records in the case that there is already an existing Lottery Capacity with this Grade Level (i.e. preventing them from creating multiple Lottery Capacity recs for the same Grade).
CustomObject.label: Grade Level
